operator_reproduction_instructions: Configure a LAB OpenMetadata bot with least-privilege READ scope over the pilot tables.
Set OPENMETADATA_URL to the OM base URL (no trailing slash), OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN to the bot JWT.
Set OPENMETADATA_PILOT_FQNS to a comma-separated list of exact table FQNs (service.database.schema.table).
The test performs a bounded READ-ONLY fetch (max_assets = len(pilot_fqns) + 5) and asserts count parity. It never writes to OpenMetadata.
